title: orange configuration
description: Configuration for the orange LLM proxy (orange.yaml).

providers.description: Map of provider name to provider definition.

models.description: Map of client-facing model ID to routing entry. Keys are the exact strings clients send in the request body `model` field.

kind.description: Client API schema this provider serves. Drives translator selection unless backend_schema overrides it.

backend_schema.description: Translator registry key. Defaults to kind. Set when the client schema differs from the backend wire format (e.g. kind=openai, backend_schema=azureopenai).

endpoint.description: Upstream base URL. The hostname drives SNI selection and :authority rewrite.

path_prefix.description: URL path prefix for backend requests. Defaults to /v1. Set for non-standard providers (Azure, Bedrock, Vertex, Groq, DeepInfra).

extra.description: Free-form string map for translator and auth handler configuration. Common keys: anthropic_version, aws_region, azure_api_version, gcp_project, gcp_location.

anthropic_version.description: Anthropic API version header value (e.g. 2023-06-01). Required for anthropic and gcpanthropic providers.

aws_region.description: AWS region for SigV4 signing. Required when auth.type is aws.

azure_api_version.description: Azure OpenAI API version query parameter (e.g. 2025-01-01-preview). Required for azureopenai providers.

gcp_project.description: GCP project ID for Vertex AI endpoints.

gcp_location.description: GCP region for Vertex AI endpoints (e.g. us-central1).

Auth.description: Credential injection configuration for a provider.

type.description: Auth handler name. bearer/x-api-key/anthropic require secret_ref. aws reads extra.aws_region. gcp uses Application Default Credentials.

secret_ref.description: URI reference to a credential resolved at config load. Only env://VAR_NAME is supported. Required for bearer, x-api-key, and anthropic types.

ModelEntry.description: Routing entry for a single client-facing model ID.

provider.description: Provider name. Must exist in providers.

name.description: Model name written into the request body (or path) before forwarding to the backend. Defaults to the model map key. Use to strip gateway-side prefixes (e.g. groq/llama-3.1-8b-instant → llama-3.1-8b-instant) or pin to a versioned backend ID.

metadata.description: Free-form object emitted verbatim as the metadata field in /v1/models responses. Common keys follow DeepInfra/OpenAI conventions.

context_length.description: Maximum number of tokens in the context window.

max_tokens.description: Maximum number of tokens the model will generate per response.

tags.description: Categorical tags (e.g. chat, fast, code, vision).

routes.description: Map of route name to MCP backends.

MCPRoute.description: A logical MCP route with one or more configured backends.

backends.description: Map of backend name to MCP backend definition.

MCPBackend.description: One Orange-managed MCP backend reached through Envoy egress.

cluster.description: Envoy cluster or route target for the MCP backend.

endpoint.description: Optional backend MCP endpoint URL used for path or authority decisions.

credential_ref.description: Optional credential reference for the MCP backend. Only env://VAR_NAME is supported.

MCPToolSelector.description: Tool include/exclude selectors. Exclude rules win over include rules.
